composers_checked.name: Cambini, Giuseppe Maria
composers_checked.note: Mixed formations only (strings in c30). Floor from Apple Music track lists, label and retailer pages; scorings from IMSLP and RISM. Gap check against the English Wikipedia work list and RISM A/I prints: added the six flute trios Op. 26 (flute, violin, viola) and the five quartets for harpsichord, violin, oboe and cello. Some Apple Music searches were throttled (403/429).

note: Cambini (mixed): 1) IMSLP's '6 Flute Quintets, Op.8' holds two prints: Op. 8 Nos. 1–3 (Haueisen, c. 1778) and Op. 9 Nos. 1–3 (André); the Tactus disc (Accademia Classica di Venezia) has all six under these numbers; scoring flute, oboe (or violin), violin, viola and bass per IMSLP and RISM 850807596 (Op. 9); keys taken from the recording, not checked against the parts (medium confidence). A Zanibon edition '6 Quintetti, Op. 8 e Op. 9' (ed. Pardini) appeared in a search listing, page not opened. 2) The flute quartets T. 145–150 are Boyer's '5e livre de quatuors de flûte' (RISM A/I C 449; keys D, G, a, C, G, A match Brilliant 95081). 3) Gap additions not on IMSLP: Six Trios Op. 26 for flute, violin and viola (Boyer, RISM A/I C 476; UT Orpheus 2022; Trio Tourte, Tactus 2012); five quartets for harpsichord, violin, oboe and cello from a manuscript (Tactus TC740303; listed on English Wikipedia; numbering and keys from the recording; no modern edition found). 4) Not added, no recording found: flute quartet sets Op. 9 (Bérault) and Op. 19/23 (André/Sieber), 'Six quatuors d'airs choisis' for flute and strings, trios Op. 3 and Op. 7 for flute (or two flutes), violin and bass, and the six quartets for keyboard and two violins, Op. 10 (Durieu, RISM A/I C 399). The Op. 45 trio arranged for oboe, violin and cello on Tactus TC740303 is a performers' arrangement. 5) T. 7–12 is a string-quartet set with flute as an alternative to violin 1; skipped here (no recording), it belongs with c30's formations if the owner wants it there. 6) The outOfScope symphonies concertantes (two violins or two flutes with orchestra) are correctly out.
